comment: I am taking Psych 200 right now. Do not take her class if you value your sanity. She is the worst professor I have had here yet- so unorganized mainly. She never stays true to when she assigns due dates and takes weeks to grade tests. She also explains the material in a way that does not make sense and does not explain labs. Would not recommend.

Now Dr. H/ She is a great teacher and cares about her students doing well. While Clinical Neuro was an objectively hard class her tests are somewhat general as long as you study hard and prepare well. I recommend her to anyone interested in learning a LOT about the brain.

Dr. Tryon is nice, but this was her first semester teaching and she definitely needs to work on developing her course more. She changed the syllabus no less than 5 times, up until the final 3 weeks of classes, making it very difficult to plan ahead. Her lectures tend to be repetitive. However, it is relatively easy to do well.
